blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— A speeding van encroaches on the opposite lane and collides head-on with 2 motorcycles, killing 2 men and seriously injuring 2 others. The deadly road crash occurred in Sitio Guilonguran, Barangay Poblacion, Ginatilan town in southwestern Cebu at 12:45 a.m. today, November 2. Initial investigation showed that the van was heading north while the two motorcycles were heading south.
